name: Nana Kofi's Rice Box
description: A rice-and-stew window in Humboldt Park the Gray Zone. Nana Kofi Johansson-Mensah makes jollof-style rice with vat-protein in a spice blend she brought from her grandmother's kitchen and has never written down. A box is Φ4 and big enough to split between two people if neither of them is particularly hungry. The rice is real — she buys it at cost from a Circuit-tier supplier who gives her the broken grains that won't sell upmarket. Broken rice cooks better anyway, she says, and she's right.
